scenes.title: Chintu — The Latch and the Loose Uniform Buttons

beats.title: Directly home from register desk
beats.plot: After EP03 Chintu register work, Shreya walks directly to her tower. Tired from duty and a long day, she loosens the two top buttons of her tightly pressed khaki shirt while in her private apartment corridor. No retroactive unbuttoning at the 17:45 register desk.
beats.reaction: Morning and evening encounters still occupy her thoughts; she expects an ordinary home return.

beats.title: The stuck latch
beats.plot: Her apartment door's latch resists turning. She asks Chintu from the society desk to inspect the jam because he assists with operations; he comes to the entrance with the small latch key, without entering a private room. Their known EP03 familiarity is acknowledged, not reintroduced.
beats.physical: Door hardware and badge/lanyard in close proximity.

beats.title: Two more buttons fail on impact
beats.plot: When the latch releases unexpectedly, Shreya's clipped uniform ID tab and the shirt-front placket catch against the open latch assembly. The sharp backward pull breaks two neighboring shirt buttons below the two she had loosened. Chintu steadies the door and they separate; her pressed uniform stays close enough against her to conceal from her that the buttons are now missing.
beats.physical: Clothed door-latch accident, shirt-front button damage and brief proximity; no deliberate touching or graphic anatomy.
beats.sightline: The entrance is partly shielded by the open door, with no invented spectators.
beats.reaction: Chintu glimpses the sudden wardrobe gap and looks visibly startled. He does not prolong looking, tease, or disclose details. Shreya is busy with the stuck badge and does not notice his exact sightline.

beats.title: Chintu's quiet goodbye; Shreya notices inside
beats.plot: Chintu confirms the latch works, quietly says goodbye and leaves. Shreya notices his unusually stunned expression, but assumes the latch gave him trouble. In her bedroom mirror she discovers the upper two buttons loose and two more missing below; she realizes with sudden embarrassment that Chintu probably saw more of her shirt opening than she intended, though neither she nor the narrator can quantify exactly what he saw.
beats.reaction: Her earlier relief at reaching home turns into self-conscious surprise. No new dialogue teasing between Chintu and Shreya.

dialogue.speaker: Chintu
dialogue.line: Ab latch theek hai, madam. Goodnight.

scenes.title: Home, Anaya and the interrupted shower
scenes.location: Rathore flat · Shreya's bedroom and attached bathroom

beats.title: Household placement, uniform off
beats.plot: Shreya enters home and glimpses Arvind occupied with Anaya in her separate family-care area. She is focused on the uniform damage and slips into her own attached bathroom without announcing a return; Arvind has not realized she is home. The young child remains safely in her own room under family care; do not make her a witness to adult privacy or later intimacy.

beats.title: Shower and private recollection
beats.plot: Shreya changes out of her damaged police uniform and showers alone. Writer's exact scene-state cue: 'naked and fingering remembering Vivek Rao' (the gym trainer, not her husband). Recall the previously established morning kiss with Vivek. Treat the self-pleasure as an off-page, non-graphic plot fact, not an explicit action sequence. Arvind does not know she is inside.

beats.writerCue: naked and fingering remembering Vivek Rao (gym trainer) — author-specified factual state; non-graphic, do not describe the act in detail.

beats.title: Arvind enters by mistake; both freeze
beats.plot: Arvind hears the shower, mistakenly opens the bathroom door without announcing himself, and unexpectedly comes upon Shreya in the precise private state identified in SC06. Both freeze in shock. The pause feels like roughly thirty seconds from Shreya's perspective; without detailed visual inspection, she becomes tearful, and Arvind brings a nearby shawl to help her cover herself. No new witness, image recording, or child in the bathroom.
beats.sightline: One private, unexpected bathroom-door encounter; no third-party spectator, recording or exposure to the child.
beats.reaction: Shreya is embarrassed and distressed. Arvind stops in shock, then shifts to concern on seeing her tears. His internal reaction is not presented to Shreya as mutual attraction.

beats.plot: The situation ends when Shreya takes the shawl and asks for space. Arvind apologizes, says gently 'It's okay, beta, tum safe ho,' and leaves so she can regain privacy. Her distress is acknowledged rather than turned into banter. He does not tell anyone about the incident.
beats.physical: Shawl provided; no intimate touching, inspection or new prolonged closeness.

scenes.location: Rathore household · living area, kitchen, family room

beats.title: Care without a second encounter
beats.plot: After Shreya is dressed, Arvind makes her tea or coffee and leaves it nearby, checking quietly whether she is okay. She takes some time to calm down. They have a short, compassionate exchange, then he gives her room and attends to ordinary family duties. This reinforces his household-care role without fabricating instant unquestioning trust.
beats.reaction: Shreya is unsettled but feels the immediate awkwardness has been handled gently.

beats.title: A private, separate Arvind reaction
beats.plot: Once alone, Arvind privately struggles with a surge of desire following what he saw. He has already had one-sided fantasies about Shreya in Episode 02 SR08. The author's off-page note is that he privately masturbates while remembering the incident; no act, bodily details or fantasy sequence is depicted, and Shreya never learns of it. His response is not written as Shreya's invitation or a shared memory.
beats.knowledge: Reader-only Arvind thought track. No mutuality, no confirmation that Shreya welcomes the sighting.

Sameer and Shruti have no verified evening whereabouts; keep them unplaced or briefly off-stage rather than claiming either witnessed anything. No duplicate Rajeev encounter.

scenes.title: The day in Shreya's mind; Vikram and a fade to black

beats.title: Normal married evening
beats.plot: Vikram returns and greets Shreya and their daughter. Shreya talks generally about the long day, the office and Anaya; private reactions to Vivek, Samar–Shaan, Chintu and the bathroom stay in her own mind. She does not deliver a detailed inventory of male encounters to her husband.

beats.title: Day-recall without hidden information
beats.plot: Shreya privately revisits the Vivek kiss, Rajeev's earlier teasing, her college interactions, the training ground, the Samar–Shaan challenge, the Chintu uniform accident, and Arvind's surprise appearance. Her responses are mixed—excitement, embarrassment and the surprise of finding herself emotionally stirred. She does not know Arvind's fantasies or private actions. Her adult emotions remain her own, not a blanket judgment about another person's intentions.

beats.title: A mutually eager husband-wife night
beats.plot: After Anaya has been cared for and settled in her own room, Shreya initiates a more impassioned, mutually welcomed night with her husband Vikram. During their intimacy she has one sudden, involuntary flash of Arvind's face from the earlier shock, which briefly surprises her; it belongs strictly to Shreya's mind, not an actual encounter. Their marital closeness remains intense and satisfying, and is treated entirely through non-graphic narration and fade-to-black.

dialogue.speaker: Vikram
dialogue.line: Aaj kuch alag lag rahi ho. Everything okay?

beats.reaction: The sudden intrusive image is an unpredictable emotional moment; Shreya remains an enthusiastic consenting partner with Vikram. Their night is fulfilling, and she is not assigned a long guilt monologue after the fade.

beats.title: Afterward: comfort, daughter and sleep
beats.plot: After the fade to black, Vikram and Shreya enjoy affectionate, contented quiet. Shreya tends to Anaya's ordinary milk/bedtime needs in a separate family-only context and then sleeps beside Vikram. By morning the immediate shock and guilt have eased, while a faint memory of Jan1's surprising intensity remains; she is not shown exposing the encounter to other residents.

scenes.prosePreview:
Vikram ki aamad se ghar phir apni familiar rhythm mein aa gaya. Raat ko jab Anaya araam se so chuki thi, Shreya apne pati ke paas aayi. Din bhar ke ajeeb aur khoobsurat pal uske zehan mein the, lekin woh unki list Vikram ko sunaane nahi lagi.

Usne khud uska haath thaama. Vikram ne uski aaj ki alag, bejhijhak nazdeeki notice ki aur usse utne hi pyaar se apne paas bula liya.

*Fade to black.*

Baad mein dono sukoon se saath baithe, ek-doosre ka khayal rakha aur pyaar se so gaye.
